newsitem.title: UK: Holliday buys Smithkline unit for $8mln.
newsitem.headline: Holliday buys Smithkline unit for $8mln.

text.p: Pharmaceuticals group Holliday Chemical Holdings on Wednesday announced it had acquired Laboratorios Julian de Mexico S.A. de C.V. from Smithkline Beecham SB.l for around $8 million.
"This acquisition is in line with HCH's strategy to develop further its pharmaceutical activities," Holliday's chairman Michael Peagram said in a statement.
Julian is based in Cuernavaca with 127 employees and currently has annual sales of around $15 million which are predominantly outside Mexico.
Holliday said it had also entered into longterm supply agreements with Smithkline and Pfizer for the continued manufacture and supply of both animal health and human actives and intermediates.
